name: Walker

notes: Returns the Midgar keystone to Plymouth so it can be formally bestowed upon Gerk.
Is offered stewardship of the Keystone of La-rel because he is the only party member not originally from Midgar.
Declines stewardship of La-rel despite it being his birthplace.
Determines that the Reach has become his true home after reflecting with Glimmen.
Accepts the Keystone of the Reach.
Chooses to protect the Reach instead of La-rel because he feels the Reach is now his true home.
States that although La-rel remains important to him, it no longer defines who he is.
Recognizes a distinctive tree from his past travels, helping confirm the portal exits near Langdale.
Avoids explaining to Plymouth how he is able to create portals.

openQuestions: What is the true source of Walker's portal-travel ability?
